result.instructions: Tools for MoveitPro+, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which leads are due for a follow-up call today?"; "Show the jobs booked for next Saturday and which crews are assigned."; "What was our completed move revenue for each month this year?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MoveitPro+ data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run moveitpro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run moveitpro_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run moveitpro_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. moveitpro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: moveitpro_create_lead
tools.title: Create a lead
tools.description: Create a new lead, as the website lead form does: it also starts a draft estimate with the move date and addresses, and lead workflows run. Every new lead alerts the office (in-app, plus email, push and SMS per each user's settings), and if the company uses Lead Lock it starts an automatic callback to the lead's phone. Use it only for real new leads, never to import old ones. Needs leads:write and the signing secret. Each call creates a new lead.

status.description: Status value as stored in this company (not 'Lost').

branch_id.description: Branch (company-wide keys; default = the company's oldest active branch) id (UUID).

tools.name: moveitpro_add_note
tools.title: Add a note
tools.description: Add a plain-text note: customer_note on a customer or lead, or an estimate note (estimate_internal, estimate_job, estimate_invoice, estimate_customer — estimate_customer shows on the CUSTOMER PORTAL). Notes cannot be edited or deleted through the API. Needs notes:write, a company-wide key and the signing secret.

tools.name: moveitpro_log_activity
tools.title: Log a contact
tools.description: Add an entry to a customer's or lead's contact log. With a type it counts as a contact (last contacted is stamped, the person leaves the follow-up due list). run_automations: true also sends the company's automatic contact emails. Needs notes:write, a company-wide key and the signing secret.

type.description: FUV follow-up visit, PISW (NI) inbound spoke with - no interest, NS no show, TC text/call, EM email, WF web form, Reviewing Only.

employee_id.description: Employee who made the contact id (UUID).

run_automations.description: Send the company's automatic emails for a logged contact. Default false.

tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a CRM task, optionally for a customer and assigned to an employee. Needs tasks:write and the signing secret. Each call creates a new task.

assigned_to_employee_id.description: Assigned employee (they get the normal notification) id (UUID).

due_date.description: Due date-time with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-25T15:00:00Z.

tools.name: moveitpro_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Change a task's title, status, priority, due date, assignee and more. Pass updated_at from the task you read (the version check); without it the tool reads the task first. Needs tasks:write and the signing secret.

updated_at.description: The task's updated_at, exactly as read. If another change came after it, the update is refused (409).

prospect_id.description: Customer or lead id; null clears it.

assigned_to_employee_id.description: Assigned employee id; null clears it.

anyOf.description: Due date-time with a time zone, e.g. 2026-11-25T15:00:00Z.
